summary: Iteration 6 — Validated Antidote toolbar button + paste history. Backend: 4 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_examsecure_v6.py validating clipboard_tool with text (counted=False), antidote_correct (counted=False), text truncation at 3000 chars, and teacher visibility of text field on events. All 4 pass. Full regression suite 66/66 PASS. Frontend E2E on preview URL covered both antidote-allowed and no-tool regression paths end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py EventIn now accepts optional `text` field; student_event truncates to 3000 chars via ev['text'] = body.text[:3000] only when non-empty. Correct and safe.
COUNTED_EVENTS does not include 'antidote_correct' or 'clipboard_tool' — backend returns counted=False as expected.

RichEditor.jsx: Antidote button rendered only when `antidote` prop is truthy; data-testid=`${testId}-antidote-btn`. Uses navigator.clipboard.writeText; falls back to error toast when permission denied. Also calls antidote.onCorrect which emits non-counted 'antidote_correct' event.
useAntiCheat.onClip: when desktopAllowed.length && target in [data-answer-zone], emits 'clipboard_tool' with text (first 3000 chars) only on paste. Correctly matches backend expectation.

PasteHistory.jsx: filters events on type=='clipboard_tool' && ev.text; words count via regex /\S+/g; 'Tout afficher' toggle only when text > 220 chars. All data-testids present (paste-history, paste-item-i, paste-toggle-i).
SessionDetail.jsx renders <PasteHistory events={session.events}/> unconditionally — but PasteHistory returns null when no matching events, so it hides for exams without allowed desktop tools. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 4 UI scenarios verified on preview URL)

seed_data_creation: Transient test exams prefixed TEST_V6_ were created and deleted during tests. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend student join uses testids student-join-code-input, student-name-input, student-join-submit-btn, start-exam-btn. Teacher login route /connexion with auth-email-input/auth-password-input/teacher-login-btn. Session cards on /enseignant/examens/{id}/resultats use testid monitoring-student-card-{i}. Clipboard permissions must be granted via page.context.grant_permissions. Dispatch paste via ClipboardEvent + DataTransfer on [data-testid=exam-rich-editor]. The useAntiCheat emit() dedupe window is 1500ms for clipboard_tool — insert waits between consecutive paste dispatches.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature implementation verified correct on both backend (text field passthrough + truncation; antidote_correct non-counted) and frontend (Antidote toolbar button with clipboard copy and info/success toasts; PasteHistory section rendered from clipboard_tool events with text).
